historicalMappedWholeCanonicalGoals.title: Raum, Matrizen und lineare Modelle (Sek II)
historicalMappedWholeCanonicalGoals.titleEn: Space, Matrices, and Linear Models (Upper Secondary)
historicalMappedWholeCanonicalGoals.description: Cluster für den geometrisch-linearen Oberstufenkorridor in Q2. Die sichtbare Oberfläche gliedert sich nun in Punkte, Vektoren und Bewegungen im Raum, eine metrische Brücke über Skalarprodukt und Orthogonalität, Geraden und Ebenen mit Gleichungsformen, räumliche Lagebeziehungen und Schnittmengen sowie späte Distanz-, Winkel-, Spiegelungs- und Anwendungsarbeit; Matrizen- und lineare Modellkorridore bleiben als eigener Zweig sichtbar.
historicalMappedWholeCanonicalGoals.descriptionEn: Cluster for the geometric-linear upper-secondary corridor in Q2. Its visible surface is now structured into points, vectors, and motion in space, a metric bridge via scalar product and orthogonality, lines and planes with equation forms, spatial relations and intersections, and late work on distances, angles, reflections, and applications; matrix and linear-model corridors remain visible as a separate branch.

historicalMappedWholeCanonicalGoals.title: Punkte, Vektoren und Bewegungen im Raum
historicalMappedWholeCanonicalGoals.titleEn: Points, Vectors, and Motion in Space
historicalMappedWholeCanonicalGoals.description: Punkte und Vektoren im Raum koordinatisieren, elementare Vektoroperationen nutzen, Bewegungen mit Vektoren beschreiben und erste Körper- bzw. Figurenvorstellungen im Raum fachsprachlich deuten.
historicalMappedWholeCanonicalGoals.descriptionEn: Coordinate points and vectors in space, use elementary vector operations, describe motions with vectors, and interpret first ideas of bodies and figures in space using appropriate technical language.

historicalMappedWholeCanonicalGoals.descriptionEn: The learner can plot and read points and vectors in a three-dimensional coordinate system and interpret them as position or direction vectors.

historicalMappedWholeCanonicalGoals.titleEn: Positional Relations and Intersections in Space

activeReplacementDecision.sourceSpan: S. 50, Qualifikationsphase Lernbereich-Kern: Raumanschauung und Koordinatisierung eA
activeReplacementDecision.rationale: The original printed p51 eA core explicitly uses a2x3 matrix of the form [[a,1,0],[b,0,1]] for space-to-plane projection and calculates coordinates for oblique drawings. Embedding its image as(0,ax+y,bx+z) yields a projection onto the yz coordinate plane; other coordinate planes follow by coordinate permutation. This supports the coordinate-plane projection action and direct matrix image-point computation, not a complete room/vector corridor or arbitrary-planeR3 projection. Partial means this specific curricular form, not every possible geometric generalization.
